territorial_scope.description: Applies to offences under Peru's Penal Code, as enacted by the Congress of the Republic.

summary.short: Peru Congress committee majority report (20 May 2026) recommending a substitute text for 7 bills. It amends Penal Code arts. 196-A and 438-A: new aggravated fraud for abuse of professional trust and fraud by phone or mass electronic media; penalises buying or selling scientific research to claim authorship.
summary.long: Majority committee report (dictamen) of the Justice and Human Rights Committee of Peru's Congress, dated 20 May 2026, on seven bills, including bill 10756/2024-CR on AI misuse. It recommends a substitute text amending Penal Code (Decreto Legislativo 635) arts. 196-A and 438-A. Art. 196-A would add numeral 8 (fraud committed with abuse of trust arising from professional or business activity) and numeral 9 (fraud committed by telephone calls, text messages or electronic mass media). The formula legal also restates numeral 7 (fraud by AI-based manipulation of a person's voice, image, audio or body movement, enacted by Law 32314) without its economic-harm clause. New Art. 438-A(2) would punish buying, selling or claiming authorship of scientific research without having participated in it, with 3 to 6 years' imprisonment and 60 to 150 day-fines. The AI provisions of bill 10756/2024-CR (Penal Code Arts. 46 and 129-M; Law 30096 Art. 11(5)) are not in the substitute text; the committee states that Law 32314, published 29 April 2025, already enacted them. The formula legal contains no entry-into-force clause.

relations.note: Substitute text modifies numeral 7 of art. 196-A, adds numerals 8 and 9 to art. 196-A, and modifies art. 438-A. Target instrument is not in the registry.

evidence.quote: Se modifica el numeral 7 y se incorporan los numerales 8 y 9 en el artículo 196-A y se modifica el artículo 438-A del Código Penal, Decreto Legislativo 635

relations.target_text: Reglamento del Congreso de la República
relations.note: Procedural basis cited for the committee's recommendation of approval (art. 70(b)). Applies to the dictamen, not to the bill's substance.

evidence.quote: de conformidad con lo establecido en el literal b) del artículo 70 del Reglamento del Congreso de la República

relations.target_text: Ley N.º 32314, publicada el 29 de abril de 2025
relations.note: Dictamen states Ley 32314 modified art. 196-A (adding numeral 7 on AI-based voice/image manipulation). Section II.1 also states it modified arts. 46 and 129-M of the Código Penal and added numeral 5 to art. 11 of Ley 30096. The committee treats the AI content as already enacted and does not re-propose it.

evidence.quote: El artículo 196-A, “Estafa agravada”, fue modificado por el artículo 1 de la Ley N.º 32314, publicada el 29 de abril de 2025

relations.note: Committee states computer fraud and use of technological means are already regulated in Ley 30096, a reason for not amending art. 196 and art. 200. The substitute text does not amend Ley 30096.

evidence.quote: La propuesta legislativa se sustenta en el artículo 139, numeral 3, de la Constitución Política del Perú

notes: Dictamen (20 May 2026) on seven bills, of which 10756/2024-CR is one. The registry title (AI misuse; Código Penal and Ley 30096) does not match the substitute text, which amends only arts. 196-A (numerals 8 and 9 added; numeral 7 restated) and 438-A (numeral 2 added). The committee states the AI provisions were already enacted by Ley 32314; no Ley 30096 amendment appears in this text. Inconsistencies: (a) numeral 7 of art. 196-A is restated without the phrase 'de forma que cause un perjuicio económico a la víctima' found in the Ley 32314 text quoted in the same document; (b) art. 438-A numeral 2 carries 3 to 6 years in the substitute text but 3 to 5 years in the MINJUSDH proposal (section I.3.2), and 'provecho ilícito' there versus 'beneficio' in the substitute; (c) the CADH article numbers 85 and 256 appear to be footnote markers. Section I.7 records that no opinions were received on 10756. Relations reflect this text only.

thresholds.note: Criminal-law amendment with no scope, eligibility, exemption, price or benefit cutoffs. The only numbers in the new operative text are penalty ranges (prison terms and días-multa in Art. 196-A and new Art. 438-A para. 2), which the codebook records as enforcement rather than thresholds. The 196-A numerals 1-6 (including 'dos o más personas') are restated unchanged from existing law and are not coded.
